scope: Independent review of the bounded guest deep-capture host-permission-denial, Try again, lazy-marker, Dismiss, and cleanup subtarget on the frozen v0.2.509 development artifact.

verdict_a_behavior.finding: The workflow-bound native driver and its uploaded observation report support the bounded sequence: a denied executeScript probe on the owned fixture origin precedes the deep-capture click; the permission error and Try again are observed while the lazy marker is absent; after removing the site restriction, a resolved access probe precedes Try again, and the error clears with the deep-only lazy marker visible. A second effective denial is followed by Dismiss and an observed cleared error. The native report also records cleanup restoring host access to ON_ALL_SITES and the origin to unrestricted/not permitted. The assertions are backed by the source-bound driver/oracle and its report fields, but no raw browser action timeline or screenshots of those intermediate states were retained.
verdict_a_behavior.bounded_claim: Guest deep capture recovers from an effective host-permission denial through Try again, preserves deep mode through appearance of a scroll-triggered lazy marker, and clears a separate denied state through Dismiss on the frozen v0.2.509 CI development artifact.
verdict_a_behavior.t14_separate_result: The hosted native report identifies itself as partial EXT-F-1007-T14. It covers denial, Try again, deep marker, second denial, Dismiss, and cleanup; Reload page is explicitly unverified.
not_established: Visible scrolling progress, full EXT-F-1007-T02, or full EXT-F-1007-T14 acceptance.
Default Chrome, Store-installed extension, or member/admin behavior.
A general zero-network-write claim: the guest driver invokes no sign-in, save, delete, or organization-scoped operation, but backend request traffic was not retained or independently audited.
